title: Leaf-script request
description: One batch of leaf scripts to run on the Zipp engine without a workflow graph: `oaiy script` reads it, `oaiy script --serve` reads one per `batch` line, and the Desktop's script host sends it. Every job runs on its own fresh Engine, in order; the reply is `script-result.schema.json` with one entry per job in the same order. A request with ANY malformed job is refused WHOLE (`{v, error}`), nothing runs. The requester supplies every file, entry point and hook name; OAIY names none. Data (`globals`, `args`, `source`, `files`) crosses into the guest only as JSON literals, never as program text.

identifier.description: Owned by the profile schema, so a profile validates on its own.

budgetMs.description: Wall-clock hint for a host watchdog. The runner itself does not enforce it; a host that does reports `timeout`.

instructionSteps.description: Instruction budget for this job, overriding the profile's. Unset: the engine default.

files.description: Module name (or `name.py`) to source. Modules import one another by name; nothing else can be imported.

mode.description: `program`: indirect eval, completion value. `body`: `new Function(source)()`. `auto`: decided by parsing, a script or else a function body. `entry`: `source` declares `entry`, called with `args`. `parse`: compiled as an expression, never invoked.

globals.description: Installed as guest globals: own keys that are identifiers, do not start with `__` and are not `__proto__`/`constructor`/`prototype`.

prepare.description: A preamble function that maps the parsed globals (`program`/`body`/`auto`) or the args array (`entry`) before the source runs.

entry.description: The module whose top level runs.

call.description: A top-level function of `entry`, called with `args`.

fallbackOnSourceError.description: Tried once, on a fresh Engine, when `files` fails to compile or its top level raises (the engine's `source` kind). Same `entry` and `call`.
